name: Uncertain Dispatch Dominance & Secondary Redispatch Bypass
production_reality: Supervisor and Reconciler retry paths can spawn fallback workers or redispatch tasks without consulting the central execution-uncertainty fence, allowing duplicated side effects if original worker is slow or unreachable.
shadow_requirement: A single execution-uncertainty fence must strictly dominate ALL 12 dispatch/retry/fallback/reroute triggers, indexed by both task_id and logical_work_id.

name: Hierarchical & Non-Canonical Path Clashing in Writer Mutex
production_reality: Production no_stacking checks exact string equality of workspace paths. Ignores parent/child containment (e.g. locking courier/ vs courier/scratch/), Windows case-folding (courier vs COURIER), trailing slashes, and relative dot segments.
shadow_requirement: Hybrid resource lock manager resolving canonical paths, verifying prefix/containment trees, and enforcing shared/exclusive lock hierarchies.

name: Deferred Financial Liabilities & Auto-Renew Trial Traps
production_reality: Production safety gates inspect immediate transaction amounts against AUTONOMOUS_SPEND_LIMIT_EUR (0.00). They lack visibility into deferred recurring obligations (e.g., $0 trial with $50/mo auto-renew or credit card pre-auth holds).
shadow_requirement: Multi-vector ZeroSpendBoundaryGovernor evaluating immediate spend, deferred liabilities, recurring cadence, and trial renewal clauses. Any potential liability must divert to Human Gate.

name: Windows PID Recycling & Process Identity Confusion
production_reality: Production process management issues SIGTERM/SIGKILL based solely on PID recorded in lease file. Under high process churn on Windows, PIDs recycle within seconds, risking killing innocent OS or IDE processes.
shadow_requirement: Tri-state process verification (MATCH, MISMATCH, UNKNOWN) comparing PID + CreationStartTimeMs + MachineId. Under UNKNOWN, SIGKILL is strictly forbidden.

name: Border Guard Scope Creep & Acceptance Criteria Drift
production_reality: Dispatches lack tamper-evident cryptographic sealing of the approved scope and acceptance criteria. A compromised or buggy planner can alter subtask definitions after human or policy approval.
shadow_requirement: Outbound task passport sealed with SHA-256 fingerprint of (goal_id, task_version, scope_hash, criteria_hash, approval_token). Inbound deliverable checked at Customs before merging.

name: Test-Weakening Worker Fix Exploitation
production_reality: A worker reporting "ALL TESTS PASSED" may achieve this by deleting test files, skipping assertions, catching errors silently, or modifying thresholds.
shadow_requirement: Structural AST diff inspector verifying that test count, assertion count, and strict equality constraints did not decrease between pre-state and post-state.

name: Durable Journal Migration Missing Field Uncertainty
production_reality: Loading legacy journals or event logs lacking task_version, process_start_time, or approval_token risks fabricating certainty or defaulting to unsafe states.
shadow_requirement: Deterministic migration adapter with explicit derivation rules: safely derivable fields populated; uncertain fields labeled UNKNOWN; hazardous operations placed on HOLD.

name: Autonomous Long-Horizon Drift & Memory Leaking
production_reality: Unattended long runs (>8h) risk journal unbounded growth, dangling leases from dead workers, and recurring task loops without progress.
shadow_requirement: Durable journal compaction with cryptographic anchor hashing, periodic monotonic lease sweep, anti-loop cycle detector, and autonomous self-generating backlog.
